nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the free metabelian group $M_n = F_n / F_n''$ of rank $n$: the quotient of the free group $F_n$ on $n$ generators by its second derived subgroup $F_n'' = [[F_n, F_n], [F_n, F_n]]$.
nodes.title: Free metabelian group $M_n$ (Kourovka 14.85)

nodes.summary: Let $F_n$ be the free group on $n$ generators, let $F_n''$ be its second derived subgroup, and let $M_n = F_n / F_n''$ be the free metabelian group of rank $n$. Let $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$ be the images in $M_n$ of the free generators of $F_n$. An element $y$ of $M_n$ is primitive when $y = \sigma(x_i)$ for some automorphism $\sigma$ of $M_n$ and some index $i$; that is, $y$ is the image of a standard basis element…
nodes.title: Primitive elements of the free metabelian group

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, every endomorphism $\varphi$ of the free metabelian group $M_n$ of rank $n$ that maps every primitive element of $M_n$ to a primitive element is bijective, hence an automorphism of $M_n$. This answers Kourovka Problem 14.85 positively.
nodes.title: Primitive-preserving endomorphisms of free metabelian groups are automorphisms

nodes.summary: The statement, posed by E. I. Timoshenko and V. Shpilrain, that for every natural number $n$, every endomorphism $\varphi$ of the free metabelian group $M_n$ of rank $n$ that maps every primitive element of $M_n$ to a primitive element is bijective, hence an automorphism.
